annotation.title_clean: התוכנית הלאומית לבינה מלאכותית – תמונת מצב אפריל 2025
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Program – Situation Report, April 2025
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Innovation Authority; National AI Program Directorate (Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, MAFAT, Council for Higher Education, National Digital Agency)
annotation.summary_en: Israel's multi-year (2021–2026) National AI Program status report and strategic plan, budgeted at about NIS 1 billion. It sets five goals: AI research and compute infrastructure, industry adoption via regulatory sandboxes, public-sector AI, geo-technological standing, and national readiness including safe AI. Defense aspects are excluded. Regulation is light and innovation-oriented.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five goals: infrastructure and research, industry adoption, public sector AI, global geo-tech standing, national readiness
Regulatory sandboxes and experimentation environments to ease regulatory barriers
Domain data assets and virtual research rooms, with privacy law safeguards
Expert advisory group, regulators' forum, and policy, regulation and ethics principles document
Defense-related AI explicitly excluded from scope
